source.title: Relevance of translocation type in myxoid liposarcoma and identification of a novel EWSR1-DDIT3 fusion.
source.authors: Bode-Lesniewska B, Frigerio S, Exner U, Abdou MT, Moch H, Zimmermann DR.
source.retrieved_representation: Primary research article abstract indexed by Europe PMC; also cross-checked in PubMed web search
source.location: Abstract; sentence reporting the detected FUS/DDIT3 transcript types

claim_scope: The primary study reports these exon-level transcript junctions in myxoid/round-cell liposarcoma. This record does not identify the fusion variant in the separate FET/ATM mechanism experiment.
mapping_status: Reported exon ranks are sourced; equivalence to the committed ENST00000254108 exon ranks is a stated mapping assumption, not a sequence-alignment result.
remaining_gaps: No fusion nucleotide sequence or accession-version alignment is supplied here.
The retained native FUS prefix can be computed conditionally from the committed exon model. A partial junction codon and DDIT3-derived sequence cannot be reconstructed from exon labels alone.
Native-prefix RG counts are not a full fusion sequence validation or evidence of ATM effects, ATR response, clinical efficacy or safety.
retrieval_limitations: The direct PubMed open returned no text, so its indexed result was cross-checked against the Europe PMC primary abstract.
An optional PMC4965313 direct open showed a browser challenge and its Europe PMC fullTextXML endpoint returned HTTP 404; neither is used to license this record.
